title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E05 — Secrets of the Catskill Game Farm
A rundown nature park is full of strange secrets and connections; futuristic machines are the forgotten result of a plan to modernize American transit; a subterranean town serves as a refuge in the Wild West.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E02 — The Secrets and Troubles of Cahawba
A Revolutionary leader visits Alabama's first capital and leaves it bankrupt; an Oregon fort refuses to engage an enemy submarine during World War II; a film studio in Jacksonville, Fla. caters to a new audience.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E04 — Banished From Bisbee
A labor strike in an Arizona mining town ends in a mass kidnapping and deportation; a unique homesteading community gets its start in the Old West; a leaning Carolina lighthouse becomes part of Civil War history.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E05 — Curse of the Armada Graveyard
A cutting edge investigation into a deep-sea graveyard of 25 shipwrecks reveals the dark secrets of the biggest naval battle in history, and using the latest tech, experts follow new evidence into the mysterious abyss of long-lost battleships.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E03 — Haunting at Lake Erie
A mysterious shipwreck at the bottom of Lake Erie could be the oldest wreck in America's most notorious ship graveyard, and using cutting-edge underwater archaeological methods, experts investigate new leads in this 200-year-old cold case.

title: BattleBots
description:
S03 E15 — USA vs. The World
In a special tournament, BattleBots Team USA takes on bots from around the world in an international showdown of combat robotics.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E05 — Curse of the Full Moon
Cosmonauts are trapped in a capsule in a frozen lake; a NASA scientist investigates the Hindenburg; the full moon affects experiments.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E07 — Planet of the Metal Aliens
Experts investigate if a nearby exoplanet could be the home to an alien civilization of strange, metallic monsters, after a new discovery confirms that life can thrive on such a strange world.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E01 — Asteroid Apocalypse: The New Threat
If a massive asteroid collides with Earth, it could end life on the planet as one knows it; new discoveries reveal just how close civilization is to apocalypse and what it would take for the world's leading space agencies to stop it.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S10 E06 — Dark History of Earth
Earth's history is marked by one cosmic disaster after another, forging the path of human evolution; now, experts explore how the Earth has teetered on the verge of destruction.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E03 — The Bloodline of Christ
Investigating the contentious theory that Jesus was married with children and his bloodline lives on today.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E02 — The Third Secret of Fatima
Three Portuguese shepherd children allegedly receive a prophecy in 1917 that foretells the date of the Apocalypse.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E05 — The Treasure of Solomon
Investigating if the High Priests of the Temple in Jerusalem hid sacred items from the Romans, and if the Dead Sea Scrolls can reveal the location of hidden wonders.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E06 — The Secrets of the Alchemists
Investigating whether alchemists such as Nostradamus, Nicolas Flamel and John Dee could truly perform miracles, or were in actuality just clever deceivers.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E01 — The Lost Treasure of the Templars
Legend has it that the Knights Templar discovered a great treasure in Jerusalem and may have brought it back to England.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S01 E04 — The Mystery of the Giants
Many ancient cultures allude to the existence of giants; tombs and skeletons of the alleged beings are discovered in Sardinia.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E03 — Murder Raid Tunnels
Hidden beneath the town of Ramsgate, England, lies a hidden network of over three miles of air raid tunnels; experts investigate and uncover an extensive WWII bomb shelter that became a permanent refuge for many civilians after a devastating attack.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E05 — Mystery of the Kentucky Cave
The longest known cave system in the world spans hundreds of miles beneath the hills of Kentucky, and containing prehistoric artifacts and ancient human remains, experts reveal a subterranean mystery that may have changed the course of U.S. history.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E06 — Buried Lab of the Black Hills
Buried nearly a mile beneath the Black Hills of South Dakota is a cutting-edge laboratory at the forefront of astonishing scientific research; experts reveal advancements engineers achieved more than a century ago that keep it operating today.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E01 — Hotel Bunker of the Apocalypse
The top-secret construction of a massive nuclear bunker remained concealed under a palatial West Virginia hotel for decades; experts reveal how this vast subterranean structure was one of the most closely guarded Cold War secrets in U.S. history.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E07 — Subterranean Silo Survival
A decommissioned missile launch facility in Kansas remained one of the best kept subterranean military secrets of the Cold War; experts reveal how this abandoned underground complex transformed into a state-of-the-art survival bunker.

title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E08 — Italy's Subterranean Secret
An unprecedented landslide unveils a hidden world beneath a picturesque town in northern Italy, and now experts investigate this vast network of tunnels and passageways that stretch 300 feet underground to reveal the city's subterranean past.

description:
S02 E01 — Legend of the Nazi Gold
A legendary train filled with stolen Nazi gold is said to be hidden in Poland; using cutting-edge technology, Rob Nelson and Stefan Burns explore deep underneath the earth's surface and in abandoned Nazi tunnels in search of the infamous legend.

title: Secrets of the Underground
description:
S02 E06 — Mystery of the Ice Cave
A strange cave freezes in the summer and melts in the winter; a massive sand dune swallows a small child in an instant.

title: Secrets of the Underground
description:
S02 E08 — Stolen Gold Rush Treasure
Millions of dollars of stolen Gold Rush treasure is rumored to have been stashed in a cave in Northern California; the search for the legendary treasure.

title: Secrets of the Underground
description:
S02 E02 — King Solomon's Treasures
Searching for the fabled lost Temple Treasures of Jerusalem and King Solomon's hidden mines.

title: Secrets of the Underground
description:

When an infamous pirate city sunk into the sea after a massive earthquake, a wealthy pirate's treasure may have disappeared with it; a hunt for the legendary lost pirate treasure of Henry Morgan.

title: Secrets of the Underground
description:
S02 E05 — Atlantis in America
New theories claim that the legendary sunken city of Atlantis actually could have been in the Americas; Rob Nelson and Stefan Burns investigate evidence that might shed more light on one of the world's greatest mysteries.

title: Secrets of the Underground
description:
S02 E04 — Doomsday Volcano Mystery
A massive supervolcano beneath Naples, Italy, may be on the verge of erupting again, which could have apocalyptic consequences for the planet; Rob Nelson and Stefan Burns use cutting-edge technology to investigate this disturbing new evidence.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E02 — Construction Disasters
Dams control water supply and generate power, but cities can be submerged in minutes if something goes wrong; bridges and tunnels make hard-to-reach places easily accessible, but when they unexpectedly fail, the results can be disastrous.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E08 — Man Made Disasters
As technology advances, manmade accidents have become as destructive as some natural disasters; a look at recent catastrophes.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E01 — Megafloods
When water unleashes its rage upon the planet, it becomes the ultimate bringer of death; whether it's from rain washing over the ground, rivers bursting their banks, or failed efforts to stem the flow, flooding is as inevitable as it is unstoppable.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E04 — Earthquakes
Earthquakes occur when tectonic plates suddenly shift and shock waves shake the Earth's surface; they occur along fault lines -- the most active being the Ring of Fire in the Pacific Ocean and the San Andreas Fault on the American West Coast.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E05 — Volcanoes
Volcanoes created more than 80% of our planet's surface, but explosive eruptions can be deadly; a journey under the earth to discover why volcanoes are so dangerous.

title: Destruction Decoded
description:
S01 E06 — Tornadoes
Tornadoes are violent, rotating columns of air that can level buildings, their unpredictability makes them even more destructive; a look at how tornadoes form and if they can be stopped.

title: Unearthed
description:
S10 E07 — Secrets of the Lost Sphinxes
The Avenue of the Sphinxes has now been unearthed in the biggest excavation in Egyptian history; using cutting-edge CGI, investigators reveal the hidden secrets of the sphinxes.

description:
S10 E10 — Lost Tomb of Alexander the Great
The magnificent tomb of Alexander the Great mysteriously vanishes and becomes a legend; using CGI, investigators piece together the evidence to reveal where his tomb lies and what it might look like.

The Red Pyramid at Dahshur is a revolutionary megastructure and the first true pyramid ever constructed in Ancient Egypt; experts investigate to reveal the pharaoh who built it and the mystery behind its trailblazing design.

Lost tapes show that Apollo astronauts heard unexplained transmissions on the far side of the moon; an amateur astronomer finds an odd disturbance in Martian atmosphere; an unidentified object in Earth orbit starts stalking Russian spacecraft.

description:
S07 E04 — How Black Holes Made Us
Black holes are not the violent monsters people think they are, and new discoveries reveal that they might have been essential to creating stars, giving light, and building the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E03 — The Interstellar Mysteries
Discoveries about interstellar space, the space between the universe's stars, reveal that it's not empty and unremarkable as previously thought, but filled with weird objects and strange phenomena that might hold the darkest secrets of the cosmos.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E05 — Mystery of the Hypogeum
A subterranean Neolithic temple discovered on the island of Malta contains the skeletal remains of thousands of humans; experts use forensic archaeology to investigate elongated skulls that may unlock the secrets of an advanced, lost civilization.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E06 — Secrets of the Crucifixion
Uncover the true stories surrounding great treasures, long-held conspiracy theories, ancient relics and lost civilizations as experts analyze and investigate history's most astonishing mysteries.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S07 E07 — MK-Ultra Revealed
The CIA's MK-Ultra program sought to create mind control methods through unethical human experimentation, and now, experts investigate classified documents that reveal the horrific atrocities that were carried out in the pursuit of national security.
